s06_f_fuchi.see: 核对过，放大看头上那一对是两条扁平的白布带往后飘，左边那条末端用绳子扎着一束桃色头发，读不出兔耳；场面稿写长白兔耳、左耳尖一小撮桃色毛
s06_f_fuchi.keep: the same composition and low camera, the slight girl with short peach hair and pale violet eyes running left to right along the edge of the dark marsh, her right arm flung up and back, her left arm reaching forward, her open-mouthed shouting face with the cut on her cheek, her torn waist-length violet cloak with copper bells along its hem, her muddy legs and splashing boots, the two wounded soldiers crawling in the mud in the left foreground, the wagon far on the left, the dead trees hung with strings of copper bells, the black night sky, the blue-green wind trails, the colours, rendering and finish.
s06_f_fuchi.change: the pair of long white shapes on top of her head, upper middle of the picture. In the attached picture they are two flat white cloth ribbons streaming back like a headscarf, and the end of the left one is a bunch of peach hair tied off with a cord. Redraw them as her own two long rabbit ears growing from the top of her head: soft and furry, each one thick at the base and rounded at the tip, with the pale pink inner side of the ear visible, both laid back and streaming behind her in the wind at about the same angle and length as the ribbons now. The tip of the left ear has a small patch of peach-coloured fur that is part of the ear itself: no cord, no knot, no tied bunch of hair and no cloth anywhere on her head.

s08_f_dagma.see: 核对过，右上那支箭箭羽在左、箭头朝右，是从她这边往荒原飞；兜帽底下整张脸（金发、蓝眼）在亮处
s08_f_dagma.keep: the same composition and camera, the tall cloaked woman in plate and mail striding fast toward us along the sunlit white-stone wall walk, her long grey hooded cloak with gold trim swinging behind her, her long blonde hair blowing out of the hood, her left gloved hand trailing along the top of the parapet, her right arm down at her side, the battlements and their long shadows, the watchtower with soldiers and banners behind her on the left, the scorched wasteland beyond the wall on the right, the low sun, the clouds, the colours, rendering and finish.
s08_f_dagma.change: two things. First, the single arrow in the sky in the upper right third. In the attached picture its feathers are on the left and its head points to the right, so it is flying away from her out over the wasteland. Turn it around: the same thin dark arrow on the same straight line, but with the steel arrowhead on the LEFT end pointing at her and the fletching on the RIGHT end, so it is flying from the far wasteland on the right toward her on the wall. Second, her face under the hood, upper middle. In the attached picture the whole face, eye and cheek are in bright light. Pull the hood a little further forward and fill the inside of the hood with deep shadow so that her eyes and upper face are lost in darkness; only the line of her jaw, her chin and the corner of her mouth catch a little light. Her blonde hair still streams out of the hood as before.

s10_f_patch.see: 核对过，左后方白帐篷门楣上一个红十字，旁边挂着一颗红心，两个抬担架的人臂章上也是红十字
s10_f_patch.keep: the same composition and low camera, the red-haired girl with her hair in two round buns seen from behind at three-quarter, seated on the wooden cart in the middle, gripping the ropes with both hands, her khaki coat buttoned up and her white apron, the red cushion and hanging brass wheel on the covered wagon on the left, the white horse on the right edge, the enormous glowing golden wheel bursting out of the collapsing red earth on the right, the line of covered wagons below it, the castle walls on the upper left, the field hospital tents and stretcher-bearers on the left behind her, the colours, rendering and finish.
s10_f_patch.change: the field hospital on the left behind her. In the attached picture the front white tent has a red cross painted above its doorway and a red heart hanging beside it, and the two stretcher-bearers in the middle distance wear white armbands with red crosses. Remove all of these: the tent above the doorway is plain white canvas, nothing hanging beside the door; each of the two stretcher-bearers' armbands is a plain white cloth band with no mark on it. The small finials on top of the tent poles are simple single points, with no crossbar. Everything else in that group (the tents, the people, the stretcher and the wounded man on it) stays as it is.

s11_f_fennia.see: 核对过，放大看头顶右侧那只角是一弯又尖又亮的金色月牙，从头发里翘出来；场面稿写藏在鬓边头发里的小角
s11_f_fennia.keep: the same composition and low camera, the white-haired woman kneeling on the path in profile facing left, both hands driving the broken branch wrapped in cloth into the earth, the green surge running up from it, the arrow lodged high in her chest and the blood down her pale dress, her long loose braid streaming behind her, the cut on her cheek, the spilling pouch of earth at her belt, the crowd of people with bundles being lifted on the green steps on the right, the tall grey cliff, the tiny wolf-eared archer on the cliff top, the grass and petals in the corners, the colours, rendering and finish.
s11_f_fennia.change: the horn on her head, upper middle of the picture just above and behind her temple. In the attached picture it is a long, thin, sharply curved shiny gold crescent sticking up out of her hair against the background. Replace it with a small, short, almost straight horn, about as long as a finger, pointing back along her head, coloured a soft ivory close to her white hair, its base and most of its length hidden among the strands of hair at her temple so that only the blunt tip shows. No curve, no gold shine, nothing sticking up above the outline of her hair.

s12_f_latis.see: 核对过，右上魔神袍子正中一竖排发光的圆圈加十字纹（准星那样）；她头上两只角又长又弯、颜色发白，翘在夜空前像两弯月牙；魔神头后一圈荆棘环也贴着天
s12_f_latis.keep: the same composition and low camera, the violet-haired horned woman sitting on the ground in the middle with her head thrown back singing, her left hand open toward the left, her right hand on the stones, her long braid over her shoulder, the glowing marks on her neck, the white-hot shackle and the burning white chain around her waist running off to the left, her dark wool dress with colourful threads at the hem, the woman chained to the boulder far on the left, the sleeping armoured soldiers on the right, the vast dark demon god looming in the upper right, the violet night sky, the colours, rendering and finish.
s12_f_latis.change: three things. First, the front of the demon god's robe in the upper right: in the attached picture a vertical row of glowing violet circles with crosses through them runs down its middle. Remove them; the robe front is dark layered cloth with only faint irregular cracks of dim violet light, no circles, no crosses, no symbols. Second, the woman's two horns, middle of the picture: in the attached picture they are long, pale, curved horns standing up against the night sky like two crescents. Make them thin, short, dark horns that lie flat along her hairline and sweep straight back over her head close to the hair, not rising above the outline of her head. Third, the thorny ring around the god's head at the top: soften it so it is no longer a clean circle in the sky, just a few broken thorny branches tangled behind the head.

s12_f_ginhild.see: 核对过，是飘起来的红色长发，场面稿写短发；照口径头发长短不改。别的没找到要改的：两手按地、小臂陶红带裂纹、两只角、抬木板过沟的人都对

s12_f_enoti.see: 核对过，左上那条大胳膊上臂护甲上一个发光的橙色圆圈加十字纹，准星那样，旁边还有一个小一点的
s12_f_enoti.keep: the same composition and low camera, the green-haired elf woman on the rocks with her arms flung wide, the twisted wooden staff with the glass vial in her right hand, the strings of green beads swirling around her, the white light shining through her chest, her torn bloodstained white dress, the great pillar of white and orange fire on the right, the green swirling sky, the enormous dark arm of the demon god with its ragged black feathers and its blade reaching in from the upper left, the war camp in the valley below on the left, the autumn leaves, the colours, rendering and finish.
s12_f_enoti.change: the markings on the enormous dark arm in the upper left. In the attached picture its armoured upper arm carries a glowing orange circle with a cross through it, like a gun sight, with a second smaller one beside it. Remove both: in their place there are only a few irregular jagged cracks of dull orange light running across the dark armour like lava seen through broken stone, with no circles, no straight crossing lines and no symbol shapes.

s12_f_dietlind.see: 核对过，右上魔神袍子正中一竖排两个发光的十字纹，大的那个外面套圆圈；魔神手里杖头往回卷的钩贴着天；另外放大看谷里成片挂灯的木杆，每根是竖杆顶上横一根梁、杆子还往上冒一截，成片看像一坡十字架，审稿人没提，一起改
s12_f_dietlind.keep: the same composition and low camera, the dark-haired woman in the torn grey dress and dark apron in the left foreground, seen in profile looking up, hanging a burning paper lantern on the wooden post in front of her with both hands, her burned and bleeding hands, the wooden lantern post and rail with ropes and big lanterns in the right foreground, the vast slope covered with thousands of glowing lanterns, the horned soldiers with banners on the left, the glowing spear flying across the sky, the huge hooded skeletal demon god in tattered robes in the upper right with its lantern, the night clouds, the colours, rendering and finish.
s12_f_dietlind.change: three things. First, the front of the hooded demon god's robe in the upper right: in the attached picture a vertical row of glowing crosses runs down it, the upper one inside a circle. Remove them; the robe front is torn grey cloth with dark rents and faint dim light, no crosses, no circles, no symbols. Second, the head of the god's staff at the top right edge: in the attached picture it curls back into a hook against the sky. Make the staff a straight pole that ends in a plain knob, with the lantern hanging from a short chain below the top. Third, the many small lantern posts across the glowing slope in the middle and right: in the attached picture most of them are an upright post with a crossbar near the top and the post sticking up above it, so the slope reads as a field of crosses. Make each one a single upright post with one short arm sticking out to ONE side only at the very top, the lantern hanging from that arm, and nothing of the post rising above the arm.

s12_f_lazar.see: 核对过，远处老神腰间是一把插在鞘里的剑，剑柄和护手都露着；场面稿写空鞘（刀已出鞘，神战正打着），这是那一下的意思，老神在画面正中很大，不算远处小人的小东西
s12_f_lazar.keep: the same composition and low camera, the broken mountain ridge hanging across the top of the frame, the huge glowing chain hooked around the peaks with burning pine trees falling on it, the old grey-bearded fisherman in the lower right leaning back against the chain wrapped around his right hand and forearm, his bleeding arms and clenched grinning teeth, his boot braced on the rocks, the immense old god with long white hair and beard in the white glare in the middle distance with his hand raised, his ornate pale robe, the soldiers and stretchers leaving the valley on the left with their banners, the river valley and arched ruins, the colours, rendering and finish.
s12_f_lazar.change: the old god's hip, middle of the picture. In the attached picture a sword with its hilt and crossguard is sitting in the scabbard at his waist. Remove the sword: the scabbard hangs there EMPTY, its open mouth at the top showing nothing inside, no hilt, no crossguard and no grip above it; only the long pale sheath itself hanging from his belt along his robe.

s12_f_sako.see: 核对过，右边营地那两面旗的旗杆，杆顶下面横一根梁挂旗、杆子再往上冒一截带尖头，像十字架
s12_f_sako.keep: the same composition and low camera, the grey-haired woman sunk in the mud to her shins, seen from the side facing left, her right arm flung up and forward shouting, her left arm down, the blood on her face and arms, her torn grey cloak and leather straps, the long snowy slope behind her with horned soldiers dragging carts of wounded uphill with lanterns, the white wind tearing across the sky, the war camp with tents and lanterns on the right, the dark red antler banners, the flying arrows and stones, the colours, rendering and finish.
s12_f_sako.change: the banner poles of the camp on the right. In the attached picture each of the two flag poles has a crossbar a little below its top from which the banner hangs, and the pole continues up past the crossbar to a spear point, so each pole looks like a cross. Make each pole a single straight upright pole with the banner hanging straight down from it along one side like a long vertical war banner, fixed to the pole by rings: no crossbar at all, and nothing crossing the pole anywhere. The red banners with the white antler emblem stay the same.

s12_f_hithea.see: 核对过，最左那名狮鹫骑手举的是白底红十字旗；她本人只画出一条腿（带腿环和长靴那一条），另一条腿位置只有飘起来的裙片
s12_f_hithea.keep: the same composition, the winged demon woman hovering in the upper middle against the sun with her huge ragged dark red wings spread, her head thrown back crying out, her arms flung wide, her long blonde hair streaming, her torn red and white skirt panels, the vast dark flock of winged warriors around her, the griffin riders with banners diving in from the lower left with the armoured rider standing on the big griffin and pointing up, the crimson lightning rising from the great white wall below on the right, the cannon smoke along the wall, the sunrise sky, the colours, rendering and finish.
s12_f_hithea.change: two things. First, the small square flag held by the leftmost griffin rider, left edge of the picture at middle height: in the attached picture it is a red cross on a white field. Replace it with a red flag with a small gold heraldic beast on it, like the other flags in the group: no cross. Second, the woman's legs, middle right below her skirt. In the attached picture only one leg shows, her left leg with the thigh band and the tall brown boot hanging down. Add her other leg: from under the torn skirt panels on the right side of that leg, a second bare thigh with the same kind of dark thigh band and a second matching tall brown boot, hanging down slightly bent and a little further back and to the right, so that she clearly has two legs dangling beneath her as she hovers.

s12_f_gomu.see: 核对过，右上崖顶那门炮炮管上一排红色的字，看着是拉丁字母；他只画出一条腿（前景露鞋底那一条），另一条没有。翼哪边歪折低垂是左右的事，局部不好改，不改
s12_f_gomu.keep: the same composition and low upward camera, the dark-winged brown-haired young man diving across the gorge seen from below, his left arm flung out, the hooked blade in his right hand, his sly grin over his shoulder, the blood on his shirt, the leather pouch at his belt, his torn red sash, his two great dark brown wings with gold veins, the crimson lightning crossing from the cannon toward his wing, the arc of winged warriors with shields across the top, the red cliffs with autumn trees on the right, the lines of shields in the fog below, the maple leaves, the colours, rendering and finish.
s12_f_gomu.change: two things. First, the big cannon on the cliff top in the upper right: in the attached picture a row of red letters is written along its barrel. Remove the letters; the barrel is covered with interlocking carved rune-like grooves and bands glowing red, with no shapes that read as letters or numbers. Second, his legs, lower left. In the attached picture only one leg shows, the near leg coming straight at us with the sole of its boot. Add his other leg: from his hip, a second leg in the same dark trousers and the same tall buckled brown boot, bent at the knee and trailing back and up to the right behind the first one, the boot seen from the side, so he clearly has two legs as he dives.

s12_f_duvan.see: 冠不改：同一位神在两幅画里戴没戴冠照口径不改。可放大看袍子上三处发光的纹样是圆圈里一颗八芒星，横竖两道光芒最长，读起来是圆圈加十字的准星，审稿人没提，照口径改这一处
s12_f_duvan.keep: the same composition and low camera, the broad man in the torn brown coat and knitted scarf seen from behind in the left foreground, fists clenched, his boot planted on the frost spreading across the ground, the long wall of ice spikes stretching to the right with frozen banners and a lion shield in it, the soldiers and tents on the left, the snowy mountains, the colossal shrouded god seated in the upper right with its white veil, its spiked crown, its enormous pale hands and its breath of mist, the cloudy sky with shafts of light, the colours, rendering and finish.
s12_f_duvan.change: the glowing markings on the god's dark robe, upper right (one on the chest, one on the knee on the right, one low on the robe above the ice). In the attached picture each is a glowing circle with an eight-pointed star inside whose vertical and horizontal rays are the longest, so it reads like a cross in a circle. Replace them with loose, irregular patterns of faint gold stitched lines and frayed embroidery scattered over the cloth, with no circles, no stars and no straight crossing lines. The crown and the rest of the god stay exactly as they are.

s12_f_narsa.see: 核对过，左边抓木头那条胳膊从斗篷底下胸腹那一带伸出来、看不见肩膀，前臂一路伸到左上角，比右臂长出一半往上，读起来像从腰背后长出来；礁上两条船是远景小处，不改
s12_f_narsa.keep: the same composition and split view at the waterline, the sea-green-skinned black-haired young man swimming under water in profile facing right, his torn silver ear fin trailing blood, his calm clenched face, his torn dark blue cloak billowing with the brass lantern, compass and bell hanging at his chest, his right hand gripping the broken timber on the right, his left hand gripping the timber on the upper left, the bubbles and light rays, above the water the wrecked ships on the reef, the lighthouse beam, the white fog wave, the small boat with a figure holding a trident on the left, the colours, rendering and finish.
s12_f_narsa.change: his left arm, the one reaching to the timber in the upper left. In the attached picture this arm comes out from under the cloak low at his chest and waist, no shoulder can be seen, and it is about half again as long as his right arm. Redraw it so it clearly grows from his LEFT SHOULDER: the shoulder shows under the cloak just behind and above his chest, the upper arm runs from it up and forward to the left, the elbow is a little bent, and the forearm reaches the timber; the whole arm is about the same length as his right arm, only slightly larger because it is nearer to us. Move the timber and the hand a little closer to him so the hand still grips the broken plank with four fingers over the front and the thumb behind, same green skin and same cuts.

s13_f_kunigunde.see: 核对过，左边炮后跪着的炮手是整颗红色龙头、满脸鳞片、竖着几只角；照主会话点名改成人脸、两只短角的男人
s13_f_kunigunde.keep: the same composition and low camera, the stocky dwarf woman with long copper-brown braids seen from behind at three-quarter in the middle, swinging her big hammer into the enormous armoured knee and shin of the giant on the right with a flaring impact, her dented breastplate, her apron, her boots braced on the broken stone, the white grass and red flowers, the cannon on its wheeled carriage in the left middle ground, the toppled battery platforms and the white stone ridge behind on the left, the gun carts rolling away, the night sky, the colours, rendering and finish.
s13_f_kunigunde.change: the gunner kneeling behind the cannon on the left. In the attached picture he has a whole dragon's head: a scaly red snout full of teeth, a frill of spikes and several horns. Replace the head with a human man's head: a young man's face in profile looking down at the breech, pale skin, shoulder-length black hair, two short dark horns growing back from just behind his forehead, his mouth shut, eyes half closed. Large amber scales show only on his forearms and the backs of his hands, which rest on the cannon, and his body glows dull red under the skin. His kneeling pose, his red cloak and his armour stay the same.

s13_f_dehen.see: 核对过，最左远处推倒炮台的是一头有翼的西式红龙；照主会话点名改成长角的巨人魔族
s13_f_dehen.keep: the same composition and camera, the tall black-haired dragon-blooded young man with two short horns kneeling behind the heavy rune-carved cannon on the right, shouting with his mouth open, his glowing amber-scaled forearms with both hands on the cannon, his bloody torn red cloak and clothes, the stone battery he kneels on, the dwarf woman with the hammer bracing her shoulder against the stones in the lower left, the soldiers with shells far right, the long line of crystal towers with red lightning leaping along them, the gun carts on the road, the white grass, the colours, rendering and finish.
s13_f_dehen.change: the huge shape on the far left in the distance that is shoving over a battery. In the attached picture it is a winged dragon with bat wings, a long snout and a tail. Replace it with a giant horned demon in human form: a colossal man-shaped figure with dark bronze skin and scarred armour plates, two great curved horns on his head, no wings and no tail, standing on two legs, leaning forward and pushing the toppling crystal tower over with both huge hands. He stays the same small size in the distance, partly cut off by the left edge, lit red by the lightning.

s13_f_grush.see: 核对过，右上那堵土墙里的锈铁条好几处是一根竖条加一两根横条，最大那一根竖杆上横着两道弯梁，左边几根小的也是，像墓地的十字架
s13_f_grush.keep: the same composition and low camera, the huge red-haired half-orc in battered armour in the left foreground, side-on facing right with his face turned up and teeth bared, both hands on the long axe handle braced under the falling earth, the axe head sunk in the ground on the right, the blood and dirt on his arms, the red glow around him, the leaning wall of black earth on the right with bones and rust-red flowers in it, the soldiers carrying stretchers uphill under it, the small white figure with a candle far up the slope, the dark sky, the colours, rendering and finish.
s13_f_grush.change: the rusted iron sticking out of the earth wall in the upper right. In the attached picture several of the pieces are an upright bar with one or two bars crossing it (the large one near the top right has two curved bars across one upright, and some smaller ones on the left look the same), so they read as grave crosses. Redraw all the rusted iron there as single broken pieces: bent and twisted bars, snapped spear shafts, curved scraps of old armour and broken blades, each one sticking out on its own at a slant, none of them crossing another piece. The bones and the red flowers stay where they are.
